value: The seeker resists the sword’s command and brings its will to heel. Quel’Delar survives the struggle; neither its steel nor the story’s inherited name is discarded. Yet victory in the Halls of Reflection is only restraint. The blade was reforged with the dark ore of Icecrown, and a quieted weapon may still bear the touch of the place that shaped it. A voice from the chamber names the deeper danger.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
